Teddy Bear Price in Pakistan (2026) - Complete Size & Budget Guide

July 23, 2026

Thinking of buying a teddy bear but not sure how much to spend? You're in the right place. Teddy bear prices in Pakistan can swing from a few hundred rupees for a pocket-sized cuddle buddy to well over twenty thousand for a giant that's taller than your kids. The gap is wide, and it confuses a lot of first-time buyers.

This guide breaks down exactly what you should expect to pay, size by size, so you can shop with confidence — whether you're surprising a partner, spoiling a child, or hunting for the perfect Eid gift.

What Decides a Teddy Bear's Price in Pakistan?

Before you look at any price tag, it helps to understand what actually drives the cost. Two bears that look similar can be priced very differently, and it usually comes down to a handful of factors:

  • Size — This is the biggest one. A 6-feet bear needs several times more fabric and stuffing than a 2-feet bear, so price climbs fast as height increases.
  • Plush quality — Premium, dense plush fabric feels softer and lasts for years. Cheaper fabric flattens and pills within months.
  • Stuffing and fill — Hypoallergenic, evenly distributed fill holds its shape. Low-grade fill clumps and sags.
  • Stitching and finishing — Reinforced seams, secure eyes, and neat embroidery add to the cost but prevent the bear from falling apart.
  • Design and extras — Bows, caps, colours, and character themes (like panda or Doraemon styles) can nudge the price up.
  • Where you buy — Local marketplace sellers, gift shops, and dedicated toy stores all price differently based on quality and service.

Keep these in mind as you read the price ranges below. A cheap bear isn't always a bargain if it wears out in a season.

Small Teddy Bear Price in Pakistan

Small teddy bears — anything under a foot tall — are the most affordable and the most versatile. You'll typically find them between PKR 800 and 2,500, depending on softness and design.

They're ideal as birthday party favors, classroom gifts, Eid treats for little ones, or a sweet add-on tucked alongside a bigger present. Because they're light and compact, they're also the easiest to ship and the safest first toy for younger children when made with child-safe materials.

2 Feet & 3 Feet Teddy Bear Price in Pakistan

This is the sweet spot for everyday gifting. A 2 feet teddy bear usually costs between PKR 2,000 and 4,000, while a 3 feet teddy bear ranges from around PKR 3,000 to 6,000.

Bears in this range are big enough to feel like a proper gift but small enough to stay budget-friendly. They're perfect for kids' birthdays, casual surprises, and gifts where you want impact without going overboard. If you're gifting a child, a 2–3 feet bear is often the ideal balance of cuddle size and price.

4 Feet & 5 Feet Teddy Bear Price in Pakistan

Once you cross the 4-feet mark, you're in "wow" territory. A 4 feet teddy bear typically runs PKR 5,000 to 9,000, and a 5 feet teddy bear sits around PKR 8,000 to 14,000.

These sizes are where teddy bears become genuine statement gifts. A 5 feet bear stands nearly as tall as a person, which makes it a favourite for romantic occasions, proposals, and milestone birthdays. Expect to pay more for premium plush at this size, since the fabric and fill costs rise sharply with height.

Big, Giant & Full Size Teddy Bear Price in Pakistan (6 Feet & Above)

If you want to make an unforgettable impression, a big teddy bear is the way to go. Here's what the larger sizes generally cost:

  • 6 feet teddy bear price in Pakistan: roughly PKR 12,000 – 20,000
  • Giant / full size teddy bears (7 feet and up):PKR 18,000 – 30,000+

A giant teddy bear creates a strong emotional impact and doubles as room décor long after the occasion. These are the bears people buy for engagements, anniversaries, and "I want to blow them away" moments. Because a large teddy bear uses a huge amount of premium fabric and stuffing, and often needs special handling and delivery, it's the priciest category — but also the most memorable.

If a giant bear stretches your budget, a good middle-ground trick is to choose a 4 or 5 feet bear in premium plush instead. You still get impressive size and quality without the top-tier price.

How to Get the Best Value for Your Money

A bigger bear isn't automatically a better gift, and the cheapest option isn't always the smartest buy. A few tips to shop wisely:

  • Match the size to the occasion. A child rarely needs a 6-feet bear; a proposal rarely lands with a tiny one.
  • Prioritise fabric over height. A well-made 3-feet bear beats a flimsy 5-feet one that flattens in weeks.
  • Check for child-safe materials. For kids and babies, look for non-toxic, hypoallergenic plush with no loose small parts.
  • Factor in delivery. Large bears can be bulky to ship, so buy from a store with reliable nationwide delivery.
  • Watch for seasonal deals. Prices often dip around Valentine's, Eid, and end-of-season sales.

Where to Buy Teddy Bears Online in Pakistan

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a teddy bear in Pakistan?

Teddy bear prices in Pakistan range from around PKR 800 for a small bear to PKR 30,000 or more for a giant full-size bear. Price mainly depends on size, plush quality, and design.

How much does a 6 feet teddy bear cost in Pakistan?

A 6 feet teddy bear typically costs between PKR 12,000 and 20,000, depending on the fabric grade, colour, and seller. Premium versions can cost more.

What is the cheapest teddy bear size to buy?

Small teddy bears (under 1 foot) are the most affordable, usually between PKR 800 and 2,500, making them great for kids and party gifts.

Which teddy bear size is best for a romantic gift?

A 5 feet or 6 feet teddy bear makes the most impressive romantic gift and is popular for proposals, anniversaries, and Valentine's Day. If budget is a concern, a premium 4 feet bear is an excellent alternative.

Why are big teddy bears so expensive?

Larger bears need far more premium plush fabric and stuffing, plus reinforced stitching and special handling for delivery. All of this adds to the cost — but it's also what makes a big bear last for years.

Do teddy bear prices include delivery?

It depends on the store. Some sellers include delivery, while others charge separately based on size and location. Toys Hutch offers delivery across Pakistan with cash-on-delivery available.

Are teddy bears safe for babies?

Yes, when made correctly. Choose bears with non-toxic, hypoallergenic materials and no small detachable parts, and always check the recommended age range on the product page.
